blocks.alt: Hands repotting a house plant into a new pot

blocks.text: A big monstera in a tight pot stops growing, and repotting it alone means soil all over the rug. We arrive with sheeting, soil and clay pebbles: repot, prune, treat for pests and clear up afterwards. A heavy planter gets carried to wherever it should stand. Materials are charged separately at an agreed price.

blocks.text: An initial estimate from a description, photos or video is free. A call-out with basic diagnostics costs 246 zł even without a repair; if work proceeds, this amount is included in its price. Extended electrical fault location is priced separately, from 350 zł. The minimum visit is 246 zł; cleaning has a 250 zł minimum and minimum hours. Travel tops labour up to the minimum; chargeable out-of-town mileage is extra. Unlisted repairs: 199 zł/h. Moving: minimum 2 hours, with the first 80 km of the agreed route included in the van rate. Materials are agreed separately.
